thread:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: multiple 502/503s from external auth provider during token introspect. Users report login failures and console access blocked. Alerting SREs and Support. https://status.authvendor.example/ — please ACK :rotating_light:

sam: acked. seeing spike in 502s from /introspect in prod-us-east-1. traffic shows retries and increased latency.

anya: support queue: several enterprise customers reporting login errors and inability to access console. Escalating per SLA.

sam: digging into authz-gateway logs — root cause looks like upstream 502 from provider, 504 on longer introspects. K/V cache hit rate low for session tokens right now.

maria: is there a recent deploy to our auth proxy? I don't see any in last 6h.

jamal: no deploys. I can confirm from infra metrics that outbound error-rate to auth provider jumped at 09:12 UTC.

derek: can we flip to cached verification for tokens that are not expired? We do have a safe-cache mode but need approvals.

ops-lead: @sam @jamal try enabling short-lived local cache fallback (config: authz.enable_safe_cache=true) for 1 hour. Monitor evictions. This lets us validate without calling provider for repeated token introspects.

sam: rolling the safe-cache flag to prod-us-east-1 now. running: curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/flags -d '{\"authz.enable_safe_cache\":true}'

incident-bot: Deploy started by sam. CI job 3421. ETA ~2m.

sam: flag is live in prod-us-east-1. Observability: outbound calls to provider reduced by ~60%, 502 rate down slightly.

anya: reporting back to customers: "we are seeing a degraded third-party auth provider causing login failures. We have enabled a temporary cache to reduce failures while provider resolves. We'll update you in 30m."

maria: checking console sessions; some users still stuck because initial login flow uses immediate introspect. Could we put a temporary bypass for the console auth flow to allow SSO cookies for 10m window?

ops-lead: prefer not to bypass fully. Alternative: add retry/backoff and route to secondary auth region if provider has multi-region endpoints. Does vendor provide secondary endpoint?

jamal: vendor status page shows degraded for their primary token API and a note about routing to fallback region— but they have rate-limited their fallback. https://status.authvendor.example/notice

derek: we can implement routing to fallback - quick patch in gateway config: authz.provider_hosts = [\"token-eu.authvendor.example\",\"token-us2.authvendor.example\"] and failover order. Will require a config roll.

sam: config change will take ~5m to roll and requires canary verification. Given customers are impacted, proceed with canary to two instances.

incident-bot: sam initiated config roll (canary) 3422. Monitoring.

sam: canary healthy on 2 instances. No regression. Rolling to rest of gateway fleet.

maria: after routing change, I see successful introspects bumping up from fallback endpoint. Error rate to primary down, overall 200 responses increased.

anya: updating customers: "we routed introspects to a fallback endpoint and enabled local caching; login success rates are improving. We are monitoring and will continue to coordinate with the provider."

support-bot: added incident tag: customer-impact/login-failures. Noted affected customers: Acme Corp, BetaApps, Cipherly.

jamal: adding more detailed logs: sample error from provider: 
```
{"error":"upstream_service_unavailable","code":502,"message":"timeout reading response from token service"}
```

ops-lead: open a ticket with vendor support and request ETA + request rate-limits lifted for our account temporarily. Assign to @maria to own vendor comms.

maria: filed vendor ticket #V-8821, included logs and spike graphs. Vendor replied: "investigating backend routing, no ETA yet."

sam: setting automated rollback for cache/route changes at +2h if vendor doesn't confirm stable. Also increasing alert thresholds so we don't flip flags too quickly.

derek: re: sessions stuck: we implemented a graceful retry for initial login (3 attempts with jitter) — logs show many succeed on 2nd try now.

anya: customer update sent. Some large customers still see intermittent console 403s when token verification times out. We have a temporary playbook to open web sessions via support if needed.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: on-call shift change in 20m. Current on-call sam -> jamal. Please do a verbal handoff in this thread and note outstanding actions.

sam: Handoff to @jamal: - cache + routing applied (monitoring), rollback at +2h if provider not stable, vendor ticket #V-8821, support queue handling for affected customers. I am reachable if anything spikes.

jamal: acked. I'll take point after shift. Next steps: watch error-rate, confirm vendor ETA, and prepare to trigger emergency fallback (read-only console mode) if errors exceed threshold for 15m.

ops-lead: good. Escalation checklist: 1) notify sales for impacted accounts, 2) activate read-only console if >30% login failure across regions, 3) invoke legal/compliance if vendor outage exceeds 4h.

maria: vendor updated: "we've deployed a fix to our routing; errors decreasing. Monitoring for stabilizing." Tentative recovery noted.

anya: support: continue triage with prioritized customers. We may need to extend credits for affected enterprises — flagged finance.

sam: closing immediate mitigation: cache + route changes remain, metrics trending down. Leaving this thread open for monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (partial). Last update 1987654500. Continue monitoring.

jamal: taking over monitoring. I'll post any regressions here.

ops-lead: thanks team. Postmortem required if vendor confirms root cause or outage >2h. Assign to sam/maria to draft initial timeline.

anya: noted. I'll gather impacted customer list for postmortem appendix.

support-bot: closing customer-facing update: sent at 09:40 UTC.

sam: thanks everyone.
